title: Salon Lead Profile (Variant A pipeline v0)
description: Structured profile for a single personal-salon lead. Drives salon_booking_v2 template rendering. Honesty rule: only fields backed by real, observed source signals should be filled; everything unknown stays as an explicit [要確認: ...] marker. Never invent menus, prices, owner facts, testimonials, or before/after.

business_name.description: 屋号 / salon name as it should appear. Must be the real name, not a page title/heading/snippet.

area_or_station.description: Neighborhood or nearest station, e.g. 健軍周辺 / 地下鉄〇〇駅徒歩5分

owner_name.description: Owner/therapist name if publicly stated; else leave empty (renders as [要確認]).

owner_presence.description: How visible the owner/therapist is on the existing site (greeting, profile, photo). Drives whether the owner block is emphasized.

reservation_url.description: Existing booking link (Hotpepper/Reserva/official form). Used as CTA target. Link only — never auto-submitted.

contact_method.description: Semicolon list of observed contact routes

main_menu_names.description: Real menu names observed on the source. Do NOT invent.

price_range.description: Observed price band, or [要確認] if unclear. Do NOT fabricate prices.

atmosphere_keywords.description: Mood words observed/inferred from the source tone

target_customer.description: Who the salon is for, in soft non-medical terms.

visible_strengths.description: Genuine strengths visible on the source (e.g. 個室, 丁寧なカウンセリング, 複数の予約導線).

site_weaknesses.description: INTERNAL ONLY — used to choose the demo angle. NEVER rendered into the LP or shown to the recipient (no site criticism).

demo_angle.description: One-line angle the demo should emphasize, e.g. '高単価コースの魅力と予約CTAを1ページで見せる'.

hero_copy.description: Optional. If absent, generator derives a safe hero line from area+category+atmosphere.

cta_text.description: Optional CTA label. If absent, defaults to a soft 'ご予約・お問い合わせ'.

risk_flags.description: Compliance/eligibility flags, e.g. medical_efficacy_language, chain, closed_signal, no_contact, strong_existing_lp, regulated_field. Any present flag should block or downgrade the lead.

source_notes.description: Provenance: where each real field came from. Required for auditability.

images.description: Optional explicit image references. Only used if locally present AND permission flag set; otherwise neutral placeholders are generated.

permission_to_use.description: Must be true to use any real/source-derived image. Owner faces are never auto-assigned regardless.
